name: Test-mode output blocking
summary: Separates a test initiation from the normal operating output under the documented test configuration.
description: Separates a test initiation from the normal operating output under the documented test configuration. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Test-mode selection” at the input and “Output block status” at the output. Any active unblocked path must remain visible.
